hh_ethnologue_comment.comment:
E17/E18/E19/E20/E21/E22/E23/E24/E25/E26/E27/E28/E29 has a separate entry for Yawijibaya [jbw], but this language was close enough linguistically to count as a variety of Worora [wro] (**hh:hv:McGregorRumsey:Worrorran**).
See also: Worrorra [wro].
